activity_summary: At the Bear, by half past five, you read the spring notes and found them less good than they had seemed before you left home. They are images from the fortnight: buds, a grey gown ten paces off, three answers at a brook. You did not add a line. They are not a play.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the old notes, judged them worse, and added nothing.

entities.name: the writing-tables
entities.context: Mentioned in Less good than in the yard

facets.activity: Read the spring notes and left the stylus
